# Getting Support for Apertur

Thank you for using Apertur! Apertur is an open-source, community-driven screen recorder and screenshot suite for Google Chrome.

---

## 🐛 Bug Reports & Feature Requests

If you encounter an issue or have an idea for a new feature:

1. **Check Existing Issues**: Search the [GitHub Issue Tracker](https://github.com/tahsinsoyak/apertur/issues) to see if the issue or feature has already been reported.
2. **Open a New Issue**: If it has not been reported, open a new issue with:
   • Your operating system (e.g. Windows 11, macOS Sequoia, Ubuntu 24.04).
   • Your Google Chrome browser version.
   • Exact steps to reproduce the issue.
   • Any console errors from `chrome://extensions/` or the extension popup.

---

## 💬 Community Questions & Discussions

- **GitHub Discussions**: Visit [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/tahsinsoyak/apertur/discussions) to ask questions, share workflows, or connect with other users.
- **Documentation**: Explore the [Main README](../README.md) and the [Online Landing Page](https://tahsinsoyak.github.io/apertur/) for installation guides and keyboard shortcuts.

---

## 💖 Supporting the Creator

Apertur is 100% free and open-source under the MIT license, with zero subscription fees, zero cloud surveillance, and zero watermarks.

You can support ongoing development and maintenance by creator **Tahsin Soyak**:

- **Patreon**: [patreon.com/tahsinsoyak](https://www.patreon.com/tahsinsoyak)
- **Sponsorship Details**: See [SPONSORS.md](../SPONSORS.md) or visit the [Online Sponsor Page](https://tahsinsoyak.github.io/apertur/sponsor.html).
- **GitHub Star**: Give Apertur a star on [GitHub](https://github.com/tahsinsoyak/apertur).
